items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee does not mention Cootie Williams; the mention is made by the interviewer in the context of Lester Hawkins' opinion.

ctx.x: No, I don't know what happened with them. They -- somehow they didn't --

Well, I -- I mean apart from any more than once personal thing, he said -- he told me I never could forgive Fletcher for letting Cootie Williams go, and he didn't -- I mean nearly everybody says -- nearly everybody says what a great lead Russell Smith was. But Hawkins didn't liked that lead. I think he thought that, you know, that was precise and everything, but that didn't -- that didn't sort of get enough sort of punch out of that trumpet section. I don't -- I never (unintelligible), but he told me that more…
Hawk was that way. He (never) criticized anybody criticized anybody very seldom because (unintelligible).
